description: Functions and classes for working with UD vector array.
notes: Present from 9.7; absent from 9.0 builds (live introspection, 2026-10-24).

functions.name: extra
functions.signature: itasca.data.vectorarray.extra(slot: int) -> array float{vector} or float{vector}
functions.description: Get the vector extra data in the given slot as an array. Extra variables accessed by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: ids
functions.description: Get the vector ids as an array.

functions.name: in_group
functions.description: Return vector group membership as a Boolean array.

functions.name: pos
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the current position of ud vectors.

functions.name: set_extra
functions.signature: itasca.data.vectorarray.set_extra(slot: int, data: array float{vector} or float{vector}) -> None
functions.description: Set the vector extra data in the given slot with an array. Extra variables set by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: set_group
functions.signature: itasca.data.vectorarray.set_group(membership: array bool{vector}, group_name: str, slot=1) -> None
functions.description: Set vector group from an array. Where membership True set the corresponding vector to be a member of group group_name in the given slot.

functions.name: set_pos
functions.description: Set the position of ud vector array.

functions.name: set_value
functions.description: Set the values of ud vectors.

functions.name: value
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the current value of ud vectors.
